title: Almighty
summary: ALMI'GHTY, adjective [all and mighty. See Might.] Possessing all power; omnipotent; being of unlimited might; being of boundless sufficiency; appropriately applied to the Supreme Being. ALMI'GHTY, nou

inlines.v: ALMI'GHTY, adjective [all and mighty. See Might.] Possessing all power; omnipotent; being of unlimited might; being of boundless sufficiency; appropriately applied to the Supreme Being. ALMI'GHTY, noun The Omnipotent God.
